ei.subject: 영어

fullPassage: We tend to overrate the impact of new technologies in part because older technologies have become absorbed into the furniture of our lives, so as to be almost invisible. Take the baby bottle. Here is a simple implement that has transformed a fundamental human experience for vast numbers of infants and mothers, yet it finds no place in our histories of technology. This technology might be thought of as a classic time-shifting device, as it enables mothers to exercise more control over the timing of feeding. It can also function to save time, as bottle feeding allows for someone else to substitute for the mother’s time. Potentially, therefore, it has huge implications for the management of time in everyday life, yet it is entirely overlooked in discussions of high-speed society.

questions.passage: We tend to (A)[underrate / overrate] the impact of new technologies in part because older technologies have become (B)[absorbed / released] into the furniture of our lives, so as to be almost (C)[visible / invisible]. Potentially, therefore, it has huge implications for the management of time in everyday life, yet it is entirely overlooked in discussions of high-speed society.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 우리는 새로운 기술의 영향을 과대평가하는 경향이 있는데, 이는 오래된 기술이 우리 삶의 가구 속으로 흡수되어 거의 보이지 않게 되었기 때문이다.
det.analysis:
① overrate — absorbed — invisible — 원문 일치 ←정답
② underrate — absorbed — invisible (A 반대: 과대평가→과소평가)
③ overrate — released — invisible (B 반대: 흡수된→방출된)
④ overrate — absorbed — visible (C 반대: 보이지 않는→보이는)

det.korean: 여기에 수많은 영아와 어머니의 근본적인 인간 경험을 변화시킨 간단한 도구가 있으며, 이 기술은 어머니가 수유 시기에 대해 더 많은 통제를 행사할 수 있게 해 준다.
det.analysis:
① preserved — fundamental — exercise (A 반대: 변화시킨→보존한)
② transformed — trivial — exercise (B 반대: 근본적인→사소한)
③ transformed — fundamental — surrender (C 반대: 행사하다→포기하다)
④ transformed — fundamental — exercise — 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: We tend to overrate the impact of new technologies in part because older technologies have become absorbed into the furniture of our lives, so as to be almost invisible. det.analysis:
① dominate — huge — overlooked (A 반대: 대신하다→지배하다)
② substitute — negligible — overlooked (B 반대: 막대한→무시할 만한)
③ substitute — huge — emphasized (C 반대: 간과된→강조된)
④ substitute — huge — overlooked — 원문 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: We tend to ①<u>overrate</u> the impact of new technologies in part because older technologies have become ②<u>absorbed</u> into the furniture of our lives, so as to be almost invisible. Take the baby bottle. Here is a simple implement that has ③<u>maintained</u> a fundamental human experience for vast numbers of infants and mothers, yet it finds no place in our histories of technology. This technology might be thought of as a classic time-shifting device, as it enables mothers to exercise more control over the timing of feeding. It can also function to save time, as bottle feeding allows for someone else to substitute for the mother’s time. Potentially, therefore, it has huge implications for the management of time in everyday life, yet it is entirely ④<u>overlooked</u> in discussions of high-speed society.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 젖병은 인간의 근본적 경험을 '유지한(maintained)'이 아니라 '변화시킨(transformed)' 간단한 도구이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① overrate — 과대평가하다, 원문 일치
❌ ② absorbed — 흡수된, 원문 일치
✅ ③ maintained — 원문은 transformed(변화시킨). 젖병이 인간 경험을 근본적으로 바꾸었다는 맥락이므로 maintained(유지한)는 부적절 ←정답
❌ ④ overlooked — 간과된, 원문 일치

questions.passage: We tend to overrate the impact of new technologies in part because older technologies have become absorbed into the furniture of our lives, so as to be almost ①<u>invisible</u>. This technology might be thought of as a classic time-shifting device, as it enables mothers to exercise more control over the timing of feeding. It can also ③<u>function</u> to save time, as bottle feeding allows for someone else to substitute for the mother’s time. Potentially, therefore, it has ④<u>huge</u> implications for the management of time in everyday life, yet it is entirely overlooked in discussions of high-speed society.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 젖병은 '복잡한(complicated)' 도구가 아니라 '간단한(simple)' 도구이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① invisible — 보이지 않는, 원문 일치
✅ ② complicated — 원문은 simple(간단한). 젖병은 단순한 도구라는 맥락이므로 complicated(복잡한)는 부적절 ←정답
❌ ③ function — 기능하다, 원문 일치
❌ ④ huge — 막대한, 원문 일치

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 젖병 수유가 다른 사람이 대신하는 것을 '방지한다(prevents)'가 아니라 '가능하게 한다(allows)'가 적절하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① impact — 영향, 원문 일치
❌ ② classic — 전형적인, 원문 일치
❌ ③ enables — 가능하게 하다, 원문 일치
✅ ④ prevents — 원문은 allows(허용하다). 젖병 수유가 다른 사람이 대신할 수 있게 해 준다는 맥락이므로 prevents(방지하다)는 부적절 ←정답
